16. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
16.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India.
16.2 Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and the rules for the time being in force, such arbitration being administered either physically through a recognised independent institution or electronically by an independent institution, in accordance with such institution's rules. The seat of arbitration shall be the place of execution of this Agreement.
